title: [MR-001] Define the versioned manual-console contract and conformance examples
objective: Publish a testable v1 loopback manual-run console contract for Vibez and Homebase.
inScope: Trace native workflow driver, service and audit evidence provenance and identify correlation gaps.
Specify v1 HTTP operations and scoped authorization for one configured checkout with already-admitted tasks.
Publish standalone JSON Schema, browser-readable fixtures, validation tests and compatibility guidance.
outOfScope: Implementing the transport or browser UI, new task admission from the console, unattended execution and browser-granted publication or merge.
acceptanceCriteria: MR-001.1: Validate versioned good and bad examples for waiting, blocked, disconnected/last-observed, accepted/reused/rejected, validation failure, rework and completion. Separate receipt, gate and host actions.
MR-001.2: Preserve exact original Markdown and stable project/session/attempt/packet, role, revision and receipt references across reads, with explicit historical-body and PR/CI unknown states.

MR-001.3: Define scoping, versions, limits, session setup, polling, retries and uncertain outcomes. Provide independently consumable conformance inputs and pinning and compatibility/rollback guidance.
validationPlan: Run all Vibez README checks, focused manual driver and JSON Schema conformance and independent QA, Architecture and UAT/Product review of the final committed head.
Test unsupported versions, missing or mismatched bindings, invalid shapes, cross-record correlation, unknown observations and multiline Markdown equality.
Check representative request/response pairs and verify rollback leaves native CLI history and package behavior intact.
